requirements.title: Partition the product into the five defined boards
requirements.rationale: Separates microvolt phono circuitry from HDMI, FPGA, display and motor noise while keeping board spins independently replaceable.

requirements.title: Preserve the reference-model boundary
requirements.rationale: eARC, UI, master volume, ASRC, muting and protection are modern system layers and shall not silently alter the frozen phono circuit.

requirements.title: Support stereo end to end
requirements.rationale: The current mono FPGA implementation is a prototype and is not sufficient for a product board release.

requirements.title: Provide phono, eARC and service digital source selections
requirements.rationale: TV audio must be able to bypass the phono RIAA model and use bypass or later line/full-amplifier paths.

requirements.title: Receive eARC and legacy ARC on the TV audio connector
requirements.rationale: A dedicated eARC receiver is the preferred audio-only architecture; legacy ARC is needed for TV interoperability.

requirements.title: V1 shall advertise and accept two-channel LPCM only
requirements.rationale: Compressed and multichannel formats require decoders, licenses and channel policies not present in V1.

requirements.title: Accept LPCM rates through 192 kHz and 24-bit words
requirements.rationale: Covers common TV PCM modes while conversion to the local model rate remains explicit.

requirements.title: Do not advertise unavailable compressed or multichannel decoding
requirements.rationale: Capability data must describe implemented behavior; Dolby, DTS, DSD and Atmos decoding are outside V1.

requirements.title: Use a dedicated asynchronous sample-rate converter boundary
requirements.rationale: The TV owns the incoming audio clock while the analog converters and physical model use the local low-jitter clock.

requirements.title: Expose eARC and ASRC link diagnostics
requirements.rationale: Discovery, lock, rate, channel count, format, ARC fallback and overflow evidence must be observable.

requirements.title: Support TV-originated volume and mute commands when available
requirements.rationale: CEC/eARC control should update the same authoritative volume state and motor position as local and network controls.

requirements.title: Complete HDMI adopter, vendor access and compliance gates before production
requirements.rationale: A receiver IC does not license or certify the finished product, and public briefs are insufficient for a compliant schematic.

requirements.title: Use a local 48 kHz audio master clock family
requirements.rationale: The local oscillator owns ADC, FPGA output and DAC timing; model clock enables derive from it.

requirements.title: Handle every asynchronous domain explicitly
requirements.rationale: eARC audio, UI SPI, touch interrupts and supervisory inputs may not be treated as synchronous to FPGA audio.

requirements.title: Provide 47.5 kilohm MM loading and selectable capacitance
requirements.rationale: The physical input must present the modeled cartridge termination including cable and front-end capacitance.

requirements.title: Provide selectable flat analog gain of 20, 26 and 32 dB
requirements.rationale: Uses ADC range without embedding conventional RIAA into the reference path.

requirements.title: Provide a turntable ground terminal and RF/ESD input protection
requirements.rationale: Hum, static discharge and RF ingress are physical input concerns.

requirements.title: Use independent stereo 24-bit-class ADC and DAC paths
requirements.rationale: Converter selections remain subject to measured noise, headroom, availability and open control documentation.

requirements.title: Provide a balanced line output and a separately protected single-ended line output
requirements.rationale: Balanced internal and external routing improves hum immunity while retaining consumer compatibility.

requirements.title: Calibrate ADC and DAC gains as a muted atomic pair
requirements.rationale: Existing FPGA guards prevent mixed input/output scaling and preserve physical-unit model calibration.

requirements.title: Retain an open-source synthesis, place, route and programming flow
requirements.rationale: Yosys, nextpnr/Project X-Ray and openFPGALoader are the required implementation path.

requirements.title: Use the XC7A200T resource class as the current sizing baseline
requirements.rationale: The routed prototype uses 217 DSP blocks and does not fit the earlier A100T resource plan with safe stereo/full-amplifier margin.

requirements.title: Expose saturation, solver, deadline, FIFO and converter diagnostics
requirements.rationale: The board must make numerical and transport failures observable instead of hiding them in audio.

requirements.title: Use a 5 inch 800 by 480 IPS capacitive LCD
requirements.rationale: Provides a practical settings surface while remaining subordinate to physical mute and volume controls.

requirements.title: Use a dedicated front-panel MCU and local framebuffer
requirements.rationale: Display refresh and touch processing must not consume FPGA audio deadlines or define the audio control protocol.

requirements.title: Provide physical source, model and parameter encoders with push action
requirements.rationale: Premium optical or similarly qualified encoders give deterministic control without placing potentiometers in the audio path.

requirements.title: Provide dedicated physical mute and standby controls
requirements.rationale: Safety and basic operation may not depend on a functioning touchscreen.

requirements.title: Keep audio operational under UI reset or crash
requirements.rationale: UI failure shall freeze safe controls or mute by policy, not corrupt the real-time signal path.

requirements.title: Support local operation without network or cloud service
requirements.rationale: Remote control is additive and must not be a product availability dependency.

requirements.title: Provide a motorized physical volume dial
requirements.rationale: Remote, TV and touchscreen volume changes must be represented by the physical dial position.

requirements.title: Keep the motorized control out of the analog audio path
requirements.rationale: Its track or encoder reports position only; authoritative gain uses click-free digital attenuation outside the reference model.

requirements.title: Use a current-limited bidirectional motor driver with fault feedback
requirements.rationale: Current feedback permits stall detection and protects mechanical end stops and the motor.

requirements.title: Implement soft end stops, deadband, timeout and manual override
requirements.rationale: The servo must be comfortable to touch, back-drivable and unable to grind against a stop.

requirements.title: Slew all audible gain changes and synchronize displayed position
requirements.rationale: One authoritative target prevents local, TV and network controls from fighting and prevents gain discontinuities.

requirements.title: Qualify the production volume assembly for at least 100000 full-range cycles
requirements.rationale: Common rotary motor-pot candidates are rated around 15000 cycles and are acceptable for prototypes only.

requirements.title: Use an external safety-certified DC supply for V1
requirements.rationale: Keeps hazardous mains outside the enclosure while the signal platform is developed.

requirements.title: Separate motor, display, digital and low-noise analog rails
requirements.rationale: Motor PWM, backlight and FPGA transients may not share uncontrolled impedance with phono or converter supplies.

requirements.title: Sequence resets, clocks, converters, model state and mute
requirements.rationale: Power-up, power-down and brownout must not produce full-scale output transients.

requirements.title: Bond connector shields to chassis at entry
requirements.rationale: ESD and common-mode currents should return to chassis without crossing signal-reference planes.

requirements.title: Physically segregate eARC, FPGA, display and motor from phono input
requirements.rationale: Board partitioning and enclosure zoning provide more reliable isolation than split-plane folklore alone.

requirements.title: Disable motor drive when stationary and use ultrasonic PWM
requirements.rationale: Limits continuous magnetic and conducted interference from the volume servo.

requirements.title: Provide independent analog output mute
requirements.rationale: FPGA zero data is not sufficient protection from converter startup, power faults or line-driver DC.

requirements.title: Fail muted for invalid clocks, configuration or control heartbeat
requirements.rationale: A stale or malformed subsystem may not silently restore output.

requirements.title: Keep speaker protection independent of FPGA firmware
requirements.rationale: Any later physical power-amplifier option requires dedicated DC, overcurrent and overtemperature protection.

requirements.title: Use a conductive chassis with isolated phono zone and serviceable board stack
requirements.rationale: The chassis is part of EMC, grounding, cooling and long-term serviceability.

requirements.title: Support a 50 millimeter-class volume knob without shaft side load
requirements.rationale: A front bearing or supported coupler must carry knob mass rather than the motor-pot bushing alone.

requirements.title: Provide production test points and board identity EEPROMs
requirements.rationale: Automated test must identify board revision, calibration, rails, clocks and safety state without probing fine-pitch parts.

requirements.title: Validate eARC against multiple TV vendors and an analyzer
requirements.rationale: A single television is not adequate interoperability evidence.

requirements.title: Measure phono noise while display and motor exercise worst-case activity
requirements.rationale: Static bench noise does not expose system-level coupling from the requested UI hardware.

requirements.title: Automate stereo analog loopback and channel-separation tests
requirements.rationale: Board release requires measured gain, phase, distortion, noise, crosstalk, clipping and mute transient results.

requirements.title: Use signed firmware images with recoverable update
requirements.rationale: Remote connectivity must not create an unrecoverable or unauthenticated control path.

requirements.title: Store model, UI and hardware compatibility versions
requirements.rationale: Firmware shall reject incompatible board/model combinations instead of applying undefined controls.
